notes:
- The next crash leaves a trace: AniSequel has no crash backend and no analytics - that is the privacy promise, and it is not changing. The cost of that promise showed up on the comment sheet: it force-closes while loading the comments, and the only report anybody could give was that sentence, because a force-stop leaves nothing behind on the device once the system dialog is dismissed. This build records the last crash before the process ends: the exception, its stack, the app version and the device model, written to the app's own private storage and never sent anywhere. Settings > Info gains a Diagnostics card that appears only after a crash, showing the exception on one line, with Copy and Show for the whole report. It holds no account id, no token and no comment text, and the app still stops - the note is the only difference.
- A posted reply scrolls to the right row: Posting a reply scrolls the sheet to it, and the scroll was one row short whenever the refresh above the list had failed: the list's first item is an error row in that case, not a reply, so the target index landed on the comment above the new one and left the reader's own reply just off screen. The offset now accounts for the error row.
